name: Draft LinkedIn posts with AI and send them to Discord for approval

parameters.content:
## Draft LinkedIn posts with AI and send them to Discord for approval

For teams posting daily to a LinkedIn company page who want drafting automated and nothing published without a yes.

### How it works
1. Reads the post log and decides whether today needs a draft. An open draft keeps the day silent; a cancelled one is drafted again.
2. Picks the next idea from a Google Sheets bank, skipping pillars published in the last 21 days, a topic family already used twice this week, and layout repeats.
3. Takes the bank caption or has an LLM write one, then checks it in code: length, hashtags, banned phrases, links, @mentions and a repeated opening hook.
4. A failing model caption gets one rewrite with the exact failures fed back. If it still fails, it is held for a human.
5. Builds the image as HTML, checks the layout, renders it with Browserless or HCTI and verifies the PNG bytes.
6. Sends caption and image to a private Discord channel and logs it as awaiting. It never publishes; the companion workflow does.

### Setup
1. Import and click Execute workflow. With `SHEET_ID` blank it runs on demo data and stops before anything leaves n8n.
2. Create the Bank and Log tabs (headings in the README) and set `SHEET_ID`.
3. Connect Google Sheets and Discord, add an LLM key and a renderer in `config`.
4. Set `TEST_CHANNEL_ID` to a test channel, then `TEST_RUN = false` to go live.

### Requirements
Google Sheets, a Discord bot, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and Browserless or HCTI. Slack is optional.

### Customization tips
Every rule and threshold is a constant in `config`. The image design is `build the HTML template`.

## 1. Decide whether today needs a post
Reads the log. An open draft keeps the day silent; a cancelled one is drafted again. No sheet means the demo log.

## 2. Pick a topic that has rested
Next ready bank row, skipping pillars published recently, a busy topic family and layout repeats.

## 3. Write, check, rewrite once
Bank, LLM or demo writer. Rules run in code. A failing model caption gets one rewrite with its failures, then a human.

## 4. Render and check the image
HTML template, layout check, Browserless or HCTI, then the PNG bytes are verified.

## 5. Send for approval
Caption and image go to a private Discord channel, then an awaiting row is logged.

## 6. Report the run
One Slack summary per run, with a warning before the LinkedIn token expires.

nodes.name: Every weekday, 08:00
nodes.notes: 08:00 Mon-Fri in the workflow timezone. TIMEZONE in config decides which calendar day the log is keyed on; set both to the same zone.

nodes.name: log in a sheet?
nodes.notes: SHEET_ID blank -> the demo log, so the whole run works with no Google account.

nodes.name: [cred] Sheets - read the log
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData: a log holding only its header row must still reach the state machine.

nodes.name: bank in a sheet?
nodes.notes: SHEET_ID blank -> pick todays post reads DEMO_BANK from config instead.

nodes.name: who writes the caption?
nodes.notes: bank: the Caption cell, used as written. model: the LLM. demo: canned answers, demo bank only. other: nobody, and the caption check holds it.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('config').first().json.llm_model, stream: false, max_tokens: 1200, temperature: 0.7, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $json._llm_system }, { role: 'user', content: $json._llm_user }] }) }}

nodes.name: [cred] LLM - write the caption
nodes.notes: OpenAI-compatible. stream:false matters: n8n cannot read a streamed body. A failure is not fatal; the next node holds an empty caption with the reason.

nodes.name: rewrite allowed?
nodes.notes: Only a model or demo caption, and only REWRITE_ATTEMPTS (1) times. A banked caption is a person's copy and is never rewritten.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('config').first().json.llm_model, stream: false, max_tokens: 1200, temperature: 0.4, messages: $json._rewrite_messages }) }}

nodes.name: [cred] LLM - rewrite against the failures
nodes.notes: The brief, the failed caption as the assistant turn, and the exact failures. Lower temperature: fix, do not reinvent.

nodes.name: which renderer?
nodes.notes: Never add a provider that renders from a URL: hosting the template somewhere fetchable publishes an unapproved draft.

nodes.name: [cred] Browserless - HTML to PNG
nodes.notes: Returns the PNG bytes. Self-host it beside n8n; the compose block is in the README.

nodes.name: [cred] HCTI - HTML to image
nodes.notes: Returns JSON { url }. The next node downloads it.

nodes.name: image usable?
nodes.notes: Checks the PNG signature and IHDR dimensions in the bytes, not the HTTP status.

nodes.name: deliver it?
nodes.notes: False in PREVIEW, which is how this ships. Everything above has already run.

nodes.name: [cred] Discord - deliver the draft
nodes.notes: The draft and nothing else: caption, approval line, and the PNG from binary property `data` (Files). After import, open the node once and confirm Files shows `data`.

nodes.name: row for the log
nodes.notes: Written AFTER the delivery succeeds. A row claiming a draft is awaiting when none was delivered would silence the day.

nodes.name: STOP: demo - log row not written
worth reporting?
nodes.notes: True when REPORT_WEBHOOK_URL is set and the run did something worth a message.

nodes.name: [cred] Slack - post the summary
nodes.notes: Never carries the caption: a draft reaching a second audience before approval has left the gate.

main.node: STOP: demo - log row not written
